plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
humanMoment: {{holder1}} and {{holder2}} recognize their own reflection in each other right away. Over time, the challenge is figuring out where one person ends and the other begins.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Your core selves point the same way, so you recognize each other fast and pull in the same direction. It's easy and validating, and it can also mean you compete for the same spotlight. Root for each other instead of racing; there's room for two.
tension: The tricky part is that being alike can also bring out competition. You may both want to lead, both want to be seen, or both expect the other person to move out of the way. What felt familiar at first can start to feel crowded if nobody leaves room.
advice: Let the similarity make you feel understood, not threatened.
